# R7 results (written by run_r7.py; do not edit by hand)

Settings of every track: heartline 1.10 m, friction 0.030, resistance 2e-05 (the program defaults). Trains: short 4 cars x 2.5 m = 10.0 m; long 9 cars x 2.2 m = 19.8 m; extreme 10 cars x 3.0 m = 30.0 m.

## Validation: the point model against the program

| shape | points | worst speed diff (m/s) | worst normal diff, program speed (g) | worst normal diff, own speed (g) | worst lateral diff (g) | points at vertical left out |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| camelback | 0.1 m | 0.0003 | 0.037 | 0.037 | 0.000 | 0 |
| camelback | every node | 0.0003 | 0.012 | 0.012 | 0.000 | 0 |
| loop | 0.1 m | 0.0004 | 0.024 | 0.024 | 0.000 | 2 |
| loop | every node | 0.0004 | 0.006 | 0.006 | 0.000 | 16 |
| layout | 0.1 m | 0.0003 | 0.043 | 0.043 | 0.018 | 0 |
| layout | every node | 0.0001 | 0.023 | 0.023 | 0.008 | 0 |

The design step of fvd2d.py (used for the redesign) against the program, same force program, compared at the dumped nodes:

| shape | worst height diff (m) | worst speed diff (m/s) | worst pitch diff (deg) |
|---|---|---|---|
| camelback | 0.0001 | 0.00030 | 0.0002 |
| loop | 0.0020 | 0.00072 | 0.0029 |

## Check against the closed form: a train on a circular crest

No friction, no drag, heartline on the rail, crest radius 20 m, arc from +57 to -57 degrees (40 m long, so every car of a 30 m train is on it when the train is centred), entry 25 m/s on a 20 m straight climb before the arc. Train centred on the top: its centre of mass sits R (1 - mean cos(offset/R)) below the top, so it has that much more speed head, and every car feels n = cos(phi) - v^2/(g R).

| train | point speed, formula | point speed, prototype | train speed (centred), formula | train speed, prototype | centre car force (g), formula | centre car force, prototype |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 m, 4 cars | 10.7242 | 10.7242 | 10.9009 | 10.9009 | 0.3922 | 0.3922 |
| 20 m, 8 cars | 10.7242 | 10.7242 | 11.4414 | 11.4414 | 0.3306 | 0.3306 |
| 30 m, 10 cars | 10.7242 | 10.7242 | 12.2649 | 12.2649 | 0.2302 | 0.2302 |

(Centre car: the car at the centre, or just behind it for an even number of cars, when the train is centred on the top.)
